A TRADE ENVOY FROM VEYR
An offer of open borders

Veyr Consortium proposes a trade treaty. Your borders stay closed until you accept.

No signing fee from your treasury. The proposer has reserved 30 credits to establish the treaty.
Mutual border access. Both empires may move their fleets through each other's territory under the ordinary movement rules.
Earn 6 credits per cycle. Mutual trust improves by 10; existing grievances remain.
Decision due before cycle 11. Accepting or declining uses one order. Refusal or expiry refunds the proposer and leaves borders closed.
Trade continues until cancelled. Peaceful cancellation gives three cycles of notice before income and access end and visiting fleets withdraw.
